scope_summary: Atomic precheck for one Workflow offer slice only. Verify artifact identity, bounded scope, affected file cluster, risk level, and evidence gate before janus-executioner starts. No routine runner, no routines UI, no Memory Session-Search, and no product transport/provider expansion.
acceptance_focus: target task identity is unique and consistent
scope stays bounded to proactive offer, explicit save and decline handling, and offer outcome persistence only
required evidence is concrete and executable
no architecture drift, provider fallback, or autonomous save path is introduced
evidence_focus: pytest coverage for offer gating, save confirm, explicit save request, decline, and cooldown behavior
pytest coverage for bounded routine intent patterns
py_compile coverage for workflow offer service and orchestrator touchpoints
scoped diff hygiene on the bound workflow task chain
